name: The Goring Hotel
insider_take: The only hotel in London that's remained in the same family for over a century – where royalty feels right at home just steps from Buckingham Palace.
whats_special: Built in 1910, The Goring holds the distinction of being the only hotel in London to have remained in the same family for four generations. Kate Middleton famously stayed here the night before her wedding to Prince William, and the hotel's Michelin-starred dining room serves afternoon tea using the Queen Mother's favorite china pattern. The hotel's own beehives on the rooftop produce honey served at breakfast.
pro_tip: Book the Royal Suite – it's where Kate Middleton spent her final night as a commoner, and features a secret garden terrace with direct views of Buckingham Palace's grounds.
dont_miss: The legendary afternoon tea in the drawing room, complete with finger sandwiches and scones made from recipes passed down through generations. Take a stroll through the hotel's private garden – a rare oasis in central London – and spot the resident peacocks, Freddie and Grace, who roam freely through the grounds.
pros: Historic family-owned hotel with over 110 years of heritage
Prime Belgravia location near Buckingham Palace and Victoria Station
Exceptional afternoon tea service in elegant setting
Impeccable traditional British hospitality and service
cons: Traditional decor may feel formal for some guests
